lesion.joint: one per pair: tasks.disabled_joints (row field disabled_joint, counted from 0)
lesion.until: the end of each trial; undone before the next placement
lesion.robot: actuator jammed (LightRobot.lock): the joint's commanded motion is ignored and its angle stays where it was at onset; the network still sees that true angle

scoring.time_from: stored time course (every 4 ticks) and the last sample
